name: text-slide-down-chars
title: Slide Down By Character
description: Từng ký tự rơi từ trên xuống 60 px và hiện dần, xếp hàng từ trái sang trong đúng 1 giây.

moworks.author: moworks

options.spread: s the starts spread over (0.45: the build takes 1 s)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Split chars; each char drops y −60 px (1.2 em) → 0, opacity full by 62 % of its move (×1.6), 0.55 s easeOutCubic. Starts spread so the whole build takes 1 s (stagger = 0.45 s/(n−1), ≈30 ms), from 0.3 s; no mask. Loop exit: fade 2.6–2.9 s inCubic; loop 3 s. Params: duration: mỗi ký tự (0.55 s) · total: cả đợt (1 s) · drop: quãng rơi (60 px) · ease (easeOutCubic).
moworks.titleVi: Từng ký tự rơi xuống vào chỗ
